detail.summary: Implemented all three independent modules: measure.Impl.to_cm (m/cm/mm -> integer cm, ValueError on bad unit), slugify.Impl.slugify (lowercase, collapse non-alphanumeric runs to '-', strip ends, empty -> 'untitled'), and ranges.Impl.merge (sort by start, merge overlapping/touching closed intervals, return list[tuple[int,int]]). Tests were not modified. Final `python -m pytest tests/ -v` reports 3 passed (exit 0). Note: test_ranges requires [1,4] and [5,7] to stay separate, so I implemented overlap/touching merging only, not consecutive-integer adjacency, despite the task's ambiguous wording.
evidence: python -m pytest tests/ -v => 3 passed in 0.04s, EXIT=0
initial run failed test_ranges: assert [(1, 7)] == [(1, 4), (5, 7)]; fixed by removing the +1 adjacency condition
manual edge-case python -c check: 200 0 2 / ValueError ok / 'hello-world-42' 'untitled' / [(1, 5), (8, 9), (10, 12)]
unverified: Behavior beyond the provided tests and my manual checks (e.g. non-int/float inputs, reversed intervals, non-ASCII alphanumerics) was not exhaustively tested
